name: Druid Mystic Wanderer
body:
Some druids wander the wide world entwining their lives with the magics of far-flung places and helping to tie it all together.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A mystic wanderer does not gain proficiency with armor or shields. They retain proficiency with simple weapons. This ability modifies the mystic wanderer’s proficiencies.

Pilgrim’s Protection (Su)

At 1st level, if a mystic wanderer is wearing no armor or shield, they gain a sacred (or profane if they are evil in alignment) bonus to their AC equal to 1/4 their class level plus their Charisma modifier. This AC bonus does not stack with other unarmored AC boosts like those provided by the monk class. This bonus is lost if the mystic pilgrim is carrying a heavy load or is helpless.

Herbalism (Ex)

A mystic wanderer must choose druid herbalism as their nature bond. This ability modifies nature bond.

Wandering Pilgrim (Ex)

Beginning with 1st level, a mystic wanderer gains a +2 bonus on Craft (alchemy), Profession (herbalist), Knowledge (nature), and Survival checks. This ability replaces nature sense and trackless step.

Charming Wanderer (Ex)

A mystic wanderer adds all charm and compulsion spells from the sorcerer/wizard spell list to their druid spell list. They must still prepare these spells as normal and they are treated as divine spells. This ability replaces spontaneous casting.

Resist Charms (Ex)

At 4th level, a mystic wanderer gains a +2 sacred bonus on saving throws against charm or compulsion effects. This ability replaces resist nature’s lure.

Gem Magician (Su)

At 8th level, a mystic wanderer gains Imbue Gem as a bonus feat without needing to meet its prerequisites. They are also able to imbue divine spells into the gem if they so wish. This ability replaces the additional use of wild shape granted at 8th level.
